unstuck_said.text: Opened upstream feature-request issue #72 on github.com/AgentPhone-AI/agentphone-mcp (2026-09-26): asked its operator to accept Nano (XNO) for per-call/per-SMS/per-number settlement so an autonomous agent holding only XNO - no card, no sign-up, no account credit - can place calls/buy numbers. note: Telephony platform built for AI agents: buy phone numbers, send/receive SMS, place voice calls via MCP server (agentphone-mcp, MIT). Agents are the core concept (each its own phone number + voice persona + webhook) - support/sales/scheduling. Controlled by agentphone.ai API key (Bearer), sign-up required, billed via API key/card - no Nano. 3b: an autonomous-agent phone/SMS rail on corporate rails
